# Portable Host Conformance Generated Solution context

Portable Host Conformance is a deployment-adapter contract, not application or
Business Module behavior. It admits digest-identified process archives and OCI
images for the declared Windows/Linux host coordinates and records generic
Ubuntu 26.04 evidence without claiming a provider.

Active24 remains a planned, un-attested target until a real target passes the
same artifact, configuration, lifecycle, networking, permissions, and failure
evidence.
